about.title: Road to Devcon India
about.lead: Devcon's impact starts months before the event.
about.p1: Road to Devcon brings together communities, local organizations, and new audiences through programs designed to amplify grassroots efforts and create long-term impact.
about.p2: Together, our programs keep the community active, amplify local efforts and voices, and serve as preparation for the culmination of the year: Devcon.

side_events.title: Side event calendars
side_events.lead: Hundreds of side events are happening across Mumbai around Devcon. These calendars track them, each curated by a different community.
side_events.disclaimer: Listings are kept up to date by each calendar's curators. Check the details with the event host before you go.

calendars.ibw: The India Blockchain Week team's list of side events across IBW and Devcon week, with times and categories.
calendars.mira: Formerly Crypto Nomads. A directory with filters by event type and topic, plus RSVPs and add-to-calendar.
calendars.mandala: Side events with the price, neighbourhood and category for each listing. Hosts can also get help finding a venue.
calendars.luma: A Luma calendar of events before, during and after Devcon. Subscribe to get every event in your own calendar.
calendars.build3: Curated by Bhavyam Arora. Side events with RSVP links, hosts and discount codes where available.
calendars.krew3: A Mumbai events directory with Devcon, IBW and side event filters, plus a venue finder for hosts.
